Name: Karkat Sprite
Author: Acidikrane
Description:
[center][/center][center]This is a simple Sprite replacement for Sam since I wasn't a huge fan of his design.[/center][center]o---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------o
Instead, give a warm welcome to arguably the best troll in Homestuck, Karkat!
This mods all of Sam's poses and is complete with the talking crab wristwatch to replace the guitar and a 'beautifully' rendered UNREAL AIR for the skateboard.

If you like this mod, make sure to swing over to the matching [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/424/?]Portrait page[/url] for the full Karkat experience. 
(I'm still trying to figure out how to modify the dialogue and his name without the game crashing; If anyone could offer insight on this I'd be happy to give it a try!)[/center]
To Install Mod:
[list]
[*](OPTIONAL) Back-up the old Sam.xnb
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Unzip the 'Karkat_Sprite.zip' file[/size]
[*][size=3]Navigate to "C:\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters"[/size]
[*][size=3]Replace Sam.xnb with the one you just downloaded.[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch and Enjoy![/size]
[/list][list]
[/list]
